title: Exact Attention Sensitivity and the Geometry of Transformer Stability
abstract: arXiv:2602.18849v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We develop a sensitivity analysis for transformer attention in a geometry aligned with tokenwise computation. Our main result is the exact identity $\|J_\tau(u)\|_{\infty\to1}=\theta(p)/\tau$ for the Jacobian $J_\tau(u)$ of the tempered softmax $u\mapsto\mathrm{softmax}(u/\tau)$, where $\theta(p)=4\max_{S\subseteq[L]}p(S)(1-p(S))$ measures how evenly the attention distribution can be bisected rather than how concentrated it is. We combine this identity with a block-$\infty$/RMS norm under which row-stochastic attention mixing is nonexpansive. This yields a distribution-aware local Jacobian bound for multi-head attention and a sequence-length-independent Lipschitz bound on bounded input sets, with explicit dependence on width, input magnitude, temperature, and projection norms. translated_title: 精确注意力敏感性与Transformer稳定性的几何结构
translated_abstract: 我们针对与逐词计算对齐的几何结构，开发了Transformer注意力的敏感性分析。我们的主要结果是精确恒等式$\|J_\tau(u)\|_{\infty\to1}=\theta(p)/\tau$，其中$J_\tau(u)$是温度软化softmax函数$u\mapsto\mathrm{softmax}(u/\tau)$的雅可比矩阵，而$\theta(p)=4\max_{S\subseteq[L]}p(S)(1-p(S))$度量注意力分布能被二等分的均匀程度，而非其集中程度。我们将此恒等式与一个块-$\infty$/RMS范数相结合，在该范数下，行随机注意力混合是非扩张的。这为多头注意力提供了分布感知的局部雅可比界，以及在有界输入集上与序列长度无关的Lipschitz界，并显式依赖于宽度、输入幅度、温度和投影范数。我们还识别了归一化放置之间的结构性差异：预层归一化残差子层的雅可比矩阵包含一个加性恒等项，其中...
tldr: 本文推导了Transformer注意力雅可比矩阵的精确恒等式，揭示了注意力稳定性由分布可二等分性而非集中度决定，并提供了与序列长度无关的Lipschitz界。
en_tdlr: This paper derives an exact identity for the Jacobian of transformer attention, showing stability is governed by distribution bisectability rather than concentration, and provides sequence-length-independent Lipschitz bounds.
